name: Gold Standard for the Global Goals
description: Non-profit impact standard established in 2003 by WWF and international NGOs to quantify, certify, and report climate and sustainable development contributions.

name: Verified Carbon Standard (VCS)
description: Voluntary greenhouse gas program providing carbon accounting methodologies, project validation requirements, and an official project registry.
source_note: Official standard body documentation at verra.org

name: Plan Vivo Standard
description: Certification standard focused on community-led nature-based solutions, ecosystem restoration, and sustainable land use projects.
source_note: Official standard body documentation at planvivo.org

name: Integrity Council for the Voluntary Carbon Market (ICVCM)
description: Independent governance body defining benchmark quality standards (Core Carbon Principles - CCPs) for high-integrity carbon credits.
source_note: Official governance body framework at icvcm.org
